DELIVERABLE: NO-GO until validated: run a fixed 10 iterations of the optimizer on a held-out task set; if the score trajectory declines the loop counts as net-negative and stays off; only a non-declining trajectory is go. DELIVERABLE: Cluster each failed trace by a three-part signature: verifier-level cause, causal status of the agent behavior, and abstract mechanism shown in the trace, so unrelated timeouts split apart. First proposal touches one surface and records the targeted pattern, expected effect and regression risks.
BOUNDARY: Not clustering on the error string; timeout is a symptom shared by different mechanisms.
EVIDENCE: Self-Harness mines weaknesses with signatures and an addressability filter before proposing bounded edits.

DELIVERABLE: Signature = verifier cause + causal behavior status + mechanism; addressability filter removes capability-limit clusters; one-surface proposal with pattern, expected effect, regression risk. Do not raise the timeout blindly.
BOUNDARY: No edits made.
EVIDENCE: Error strings alone merge unrelated causes.
